paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Menashi: Megillah 14a; beginning of Kilayim has Menasheh. He and R. Shmuel bar Nachman are named together in Jerusalem Taanit, beginning of chapter 2. Psalms Midrash, section 1; Yalkut, I Samuel 2, has Menashya. Rav Menashya bar Yehudah was his son or father.
